inclusion.incomplete_position_policy: Each quality-passing allele retained; missing siblings do not discard valid rows
inclusion.source_scope: Input records are already reference-validated SNVs; caller must retain raw non-SNV/source-status accounting and source manifest commitments

limitations: Retrospective selected public promoters from one study; neither random sampling nor independent laboratory replication is established

HBB outcomes were explored previously. Models, fixed alpha/features, final protocol and new cohort selection were fixed before the new score acquisition; no pristine-HBB or external preregistration claim
Training rows have equal weight, while errors average alleles per position and then loci; cell contexts and assay scales may differ and are never normalized using test outcomes
Blocked HBB centers have disjoint radius10 sequence supports, but source/library dependence and biology can remain. Row-random diagnostic is deliberately leaky and not a model-selection criterion
JASPAR log-odds deltas are sequence-similarity features, not TF binding or expression measurements; missing TBP taxonomy is retained in the motif source metadata
Bootstrap intervals condition on fixed OOF predictions. Artificial spatial rotations test a chosen null transformation and are not calibrated biological-significance p-values
Every planned model/control and negative result is retained; no discovery or causal mechanism is declared from thresholds

metric_arithmetic.constant_predictions: Identical per-position predictions preserve the exact value before position-rank calculation
metric_arithmetic.observed_position_means: Exact rational arithmetic on original source CSV decimals; exact fractions determine observed position rank ties, and are converted to f64 only for numeric display and nonrank metrics
metric_arithmetic.predicted_values: Actual f64 ridge predictions without quantization, epsilon ties or rounding; identical unscaled feature rows receive one evaluated prediction per fit
metric_arithmetic.unchanged_scientific_protocol: Numerical correctness fixes preserve the frozen models/features/folds/alpha/controls; no outcome-driven parameter selection

replication_policy: Independent numerical comparison is a separate required verification bundle. This artifact alone does not claim reproduction or biological novelty.
secondary_rank_limit: Exact-tie Spearman can be sensitive to floating reduction order. Preserve attempted comparisons and distinguish replicated continuous losses from unresolved rank endpoints.
